rules.context: Fresh scyther, no resistance modifier, direct native damage application
rules.repeatAt100Ticks: No refresh while adapted in all 24 mech controls; full initial duration was timed until clear.
rules.limits: Other races, resistance stats and DamageDef constant-duration overrides require reevaluation. Not injury damage.

rules.input: EMP versus ordinary bare or shielded human
rules.shieldResult: All 24 shield controls emptied the shield and entered Resetting at all three EMP amounts.
rules.limits: Ordinary human without relevant implants. Additional EMP-sensitive implants/equipment not covered.

rules.input: Nerve damage amount and weapon quality
rules.context: Direct torso hits, amounts 1/15/30, four seeds per quality/profile; all survive
rules.limits: Requires positive injury and a surviving non-mech target. Full body-size curve and stun resistance still apply.

rules.input: BlindSmoke on a valid ordinary rifle shoot line
rules.stacking: One nonzero smoke cell and many dense smoke cells gave the same report; clearing restored baseline in all eight controls.
rules.limits: Tested above the native accuracy floor with no unique trait bypass. Not a universal 30 percentage-point subtraction, and not turret-lock testing.
